pairs.registryProposal: Only 2 of voice-io's 21 techniques govern a context that merely reports voice availability and links to the voice flow; the evidence floor (half of 21) was met only by anchoring ten not-applicable techniques to one delegation comment. Consider letting conform count the floor over techniques whose precondition holds, or splitting a thin 'voice-availability-surface' slice so such contexts are not matched to the whole pipeline subject.

pairs.evidence: apps/desktop/src/scenes/mind/devices.test.tsx:7 the Devices/pairing/vitals/sleep journeys added 2026-10-24 are exercised only as static renders of fixtures and a driven tree with faked actions and a hand-built fetch (apps/desktop/src/stores/devices.test.ts:74); the live lane (apps/desktop/e2e/client.e2e.test.ts:69,121) covers /manifest, /decisions and /ledger only, so a daemon-side rename of a /peer, /sleep or vitals field leaves the whole fleet suite green while the Mind level breaks (live-app-harness: the assembled product is never driven through pairing)

apps/desktop/src/scenes/mind/mind.css.test.ts:6 the sheet is comment-stripped before matching, :12 the rule helper throws on an absent selector, :32 the hover pin asserts a declaration; the 2026-10-14 deviation (css.includes on unstripped CSS) is closed, and surface.css.test.ts:25 does the same
apps/desktop/src/scenes/mind/devices.test.tsx:544 the re-read beat is proved with fake timers and call counts, not wall-clock waits

apps/desktop/src/scenes/mind/devices.test.tsx:544 the drawer's re-read decision is reached by pressing the node, with the phone case asserted not to call load; qr is faked there on purpose and pinned separately in qr.test.ts

apps/desktop/vite.config.ts:128 the unit include is a literal glob list, not a computed tag selection, and apps/desktop/package.json:29 keeps the e2e run on its own config so neither lane can swallow the other
apps/desktop/src/scenes/mind/fixtures.ts:2 the scene fixtures reuse the Setup module's view-models with nothing re-derived

apps/desktop/src/scenes/mind/qr.test.ts:2 the QR encoder runs no decoder; it is held by BCH-checked format/version words and three whole matrices pinned from two independent encoders, which covers the shipped 78-byte pairing URL (version 5) but not versions 6-10 beyond structure (registry note below)

pairs.registryProposal: assert-through-the-reader says the reader is the oracle and a string pin is the weak form; here the emitted artifact is a QR bitmap and the pinned oracle is two independent encoders that agreed module for module, not a decoder. That is a third far-side shape (independent producers as oracle) the technique and its 'when not to use' do not name. Worth an application note with qr.test.ts as evidence.

pairs.subject: motion
pairs.evidence: apps/desktop/src/scenes/mind/mind.css:345 every online link in the Devices constellation runs sky-flow, marching dashes on stroke-dashoffset (a paint property) forever at an inline 2.8s, one instance per paired device with no count bound, so an idle fleet reads as data in transit; ambient motion may imply presence, never progress (taste-budgets) and the vocabulary's presets are transform/opacity only (performance-discipline)

techniques.evidence: apps/desktop/src/scenes/mind/constellation.tsx:207 the flow line is drawn for every online link, an ambient loop implying transfer while nothing transfers; instances scale with fleet size instead of a per-view budget

apps/desktop/src/scenes/mind/mind.css:345 animates stroke-dashoffset continuously (keyframes at :365 animate stroke-dashoffset), a repaint every frame per link, rather than a compositor-friendly property

apps/desktop/src/scenes/mind/mind.css:358 loop periods 2.8s/2.4s/2.2s/1.2s (:345,:358,:511,:1074) are inlined in seven local keyframes instead of drawn from a named preset or the duration ladder; the depth clock (styles/app.css:918) is tokenised but the ambient loops are not

apps/desktop/src/scenes/mind/mind.css:1110 every new loop is stopped under Calm (animation: none at :1115) and the depth moves land at once via the 0ms token (apps/desktop/src/styles/app.css:918); the wizard's fold cannot wedge because wizard.tsx:312 unmounts on a safety timer when animationend never fires

apps/desktop/src/scenes/mind/mind.css:275 the loops are unprompted and run past five seconds; the person's Calm choice (apps/desktop/src/lib/motion.ts) is the visible stop and it persists, nothing re-arms it

pairs.registryProposal: The 2026-10-16 deviation (hover eases background/border-color and Mind/Surface sheets do not settle them under Calm) was re-read against reduced-motion-mechanics ('reduced is not none', one-shot fades survive, feedback is the class that must never be cut) and taste-budgets (feedback entitled to immediacy): a 150ms colour ease on a pressed control is feedback, not a violation. That verdict is superseded by this one. Separately, apps/desktop/src/styles/app.css:872-885 is the universal 1ms reset that reduced-motion-mechanics names the global-kill trap (outside this context; flagged for the app-shell context).
